candidate_name: GNL Mejillones "tercer terminal" / medium-scale LNG distribution hub
current_state: Concept/feasibility stage. GNL Mejillones is doing feasibility engineering on a SECOND storage tank that would enable medium-scale LNG coastal shipping (cabotaje) to supply a future 'tercer terminal' (third LNG terminal) in the centre-south zone. No specific site, sponsor, or concrete step for the third terminal itself yet.
missing_threshold_elements: location (no named site for the third terminal); concrete step (only feasibility engineering on the enabling Mejillones tank, not the third terminal); sponsor of the third terminal undefined
watch_for: FID or site selection for the Mejillones second storage tank; any named site/sponsor for the centre-south medium-scale regas terminal it would feed
notes: Operator's own projects page describes the 'tercer terminal' as a downstream possibility of the medium-scale strategy, not a defined project. Re-check ~mid-2027.

candidate_name: GNL Zona Sur (Gas Natural Zona Sur) -- Huachipato/Talcahuano regasification
sponsor_or_proposer: Grupo CAP (CAP Acero); Enel Generación Chile
current_state: Withdrawn/abandoned. Onshore LNG regasification + truck-loading project on CAP's Huachipato steelworks in San Vicente bay, Talcahuano. Entered SEIA 14-Feb-2020 (~US$104M); CAP filed to withdraw the DIA on 18-Dec-2020 and dropped the project. Never built.
missing_threshold_elements: active sponsor (withdrawn ~5.5 years ago); concrete step (DIA withdrawn before approval)
watch_for: Any revival of an LNG terminal on the CAP Huachipato site (CAP/Enel or a new sponsor). Distinct from the existing GEM 'Talcahuano FSRU' (Inversiones GNL Talcahuano SpA).
notes: Recorded so it is not re-discovered as a 'missing' terminal each sweep. Dead since 2020; not staged as a new_terminal (no recent activity, never advanced past DIA, withdrawn by sponsor).
